user_story: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a booking successfully
steps: Staff member accesses the booking system
Staff member selects a booking to confirm
Staff member clicks on the 'Confirm Booking' button
System notifies the staff member that the booking is confirmed
System sends a confirmation message to the guest
positive.expected_result: The booking is confirmed and the guest receives a confirmation message.

negative.title: Attempt to confirm a booking that does not exist
steps: Staff member accesses the booking system
Staff member enters an invalid booking ID
Staff member clicks on the 'Confirm Booking' button
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Confirm a booking with special characters in the guest's name
steps: Staff member accesses the booking system
Staff member selects a booking with special characters in the guest's name (e.g., 'Jane O'Connor')
Staff member clicks on the 'Confirm Booking' button
edge.expected_result: The booking is confirmed correctly without issues, and the guest receives a confirmation message.
